title: HDR exposure merges in Select
objective: Create durable editable HDR assets from selected brackets, show result-led reversible stacks, keep originals individually pickable, and make Pick merged append to the development set by default through the shared command service.
context_summary: Planning requested and RAW-only/automatic alignment/deghosting selected on 2026-10-07; implementation is not authorized. TASK-001 storage, TASK-002 RAW radiance and TASK-003 registration/deghosting are independently ready; remaining dependencies represent required outputs. Routine algorithms, thresholds/backends and layout are implementer choices within the design. Deliver ordinary correctness and a working background-verified feature in TASK-009 before extensive natural-scene quality and quiet-host timing in TASK-010. No JPEG bracket inputs, panorama work, placeholder controls, generated-input graph, automatic regeneration, compatibility shims or approval/research task is included. Use roadmap high-tier models and re-review current main.

acceptance_criteria: An implemented repeatable harness covers declared 24/60 MP three/nine exposure workloads and reports actual stage distributions, resource peaks, cancellation and merge/editor contention.
Reopen/redo of a healthy saved source performs zero input reads and zero fusion work; disk/object accounting covers retained and temporary data.
Available natural-bracket cases have named expectations and recorded output/failure diagnostics; absent/unrun cases remain explicitly unqualified.

Any quality/resource fix has focused correctness/rendered evidence; performance/design/features docs report current figures and remaining limits without a broad unmeasured memory or portability claim.

steps: Prepare deterministic photo-sized scene/exposure workloads and natural-scene case manifests without blocking on private inputs.
Measure once on the completed feature behind the host lock; correlate resources, stage logs and editor/browse latency with input/result sizes.
Inspect motion, seams, colour, highlights, shadows and crop losses for available real brackets; record exact scope and address measured failures.
expected_results: Every stated acceptance check passes with recorded scope; skipped checks are not passes.
